title: prior-art-search collision-record
description: prior-art-search's TOP-LINE output — the honest collision-coverage disclosure. Carries the named signal `collisions_under_known_coverage` (the ONLY permitted top-line string; `novel_confirmed` is FORBIDDEN and never appears — enforced by coverage_policy_check.py) and the per-claim counts N/U/C/I of M. The coverage disclosure, NOT a verdict, is the contract (proposal §3 step 4, §8 Q3). Analogous to psv's split: prior-art-search emits collision-findings (per-claim collisions) AND this collision-record (the top-line disclosure). M=0 (no extractable novelty claims — a doc making no novelty assertion, or all novelty claims interpretive) and I>0 (claims extracted but the search couldn't cover them) both ESCALATE to a human, never a silent pass (rule 3). Carries `rightness: human_confirm_required` as a constant — a coverage disclosure never certifies the doc is novel.

artifact.description: Path/ref to the doc-shaped artifact whose novelty claims were collision-checked.

signal.description: The sole permitted top-line signal. prior-art-search NEVER emits 'novel_confirmed' or any boolean 'the doc is novel' — coverage_policy_check.py asserts this string is the only top-line value present.

counts.description: N/U/C/I of M. coverage_policy_check.py asserts total_extracted = collisions + uncited_relevant + clear_under_search + inconclusive.

collisions.description: N — novelty claims where found prior art already makes the claim (each a blocker finding with a fetched quote of the found prior-art text). The doc overstates novelty here.

uncited_relevant.description: U — novelty claims where found relevant work the doc didn't cite (each a warning finding with a fetched quote). A coverage gap, not a direct collision.

clear_under_search.description: C — novelty claims with no collision found IN THE SEARCHED CORPUS (NOT 'novel' — the comparison model found no collision; not a proof none exists — comparison + selection blind-spot caveats). Counted here, NOT listed as findings.

inconclusive.description: I — novelty claims the search could not cover (paywalled corpus, ambiguous query, nothing findable). Each escalates to a human.

total_extracted.description: M — total atomic novelty claims extracted. M = N + U + C + I. M=0 means prior-art-search had no novelty surface on this artifact (the doc makes no novelty assertion, or all novelty claims are interpretive) -> escalates to a human (distinct from I>0).

rightness.description: Outcome-axis constant. A coverage disclosure NEVER changes this — prior-art-search does not judge whether the doc is genuinely novel.

claim_ref.description: The inconclusive claim's location/id, when this escalation is an I>0 claim. Absent for the M=0 (no novelty surface) escalation.

reason.description: Why it escalates: 'search could not cover this claim' (I>0) or 'no extractable novelty claims — prior-art-search has no novelty surface on this artifact' (M=0).

escalations.description: Human escalations: every I>0 claim (one entry each) PLUS one M=0 entry when total_extracted=0. Never empty when I>0 or M=0.

coverage.description: Honest coverage notes (workspace rule 3): the extractor blind-spot (claims neither party could see are absent from M), the comparison blind-spot (`clear-under-search` != 'no collision exists'), and the SELECTION-side weakness (ranking bias, recall limits, found text is model-extracted — the second oracle-weakness layer beyond psv's comparison-side one). Plus any search-source degradation. Never silent.
